meta_title: Pakistan Passport Photo Size (35×45 mm) & Rules | Resize-It
meta_description: Pakistani passport and visa photos are 45 × 35 mm on a plain white background, taken in the last 6 months, with a neutral expression. Check the DGIP rules and crop yours.
h1: Pakistan Passport Photo Size and Requirements
subtitle: Crop your photo to 45 × 35 mm on white, checked against Directorate General of Immigration & Passports (DGIP) guidance.

tool_workspace.description: Upload a photo to crop it to the official size. Everything is processed in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

rows.label: Framing
rows.value: Close-up of your full head and shoulders

rows.label: Pose
rows.value: Facing forward, looking straight at the camera, with a neutral expression and no shadows

rows.label: Editing
rows.value: Not edited in software such as Photoshop

rows.label: Online renewal
rows.value: DGIP asks for a professionally taken photo; a photo cropped out of a larger picture is not accepted

notes: For online renewal, DGIP wants a professionally taken photo rather than a crop of a larger picture. Use this page to check the rules and your framing first.
Use the photo check on the DGIP online renewal portal before you submit; its upload rules are the ones that will be enforced.
Print the PDF sheet at 100% scale so each photo is exactly 45 × 35 mm.
requirements.checked: Checked against these sources in November 2026. Rules change, so confirm on the official page before you apply.

how_to.title: How to make a Pakistani passport photo
how_to.step1_text: Stand in front of a plain background in even light and have someone else take the photo at eye level. Follow the Pakistani rules below.
how_to.step2_text: Choose the photo. It is processed in your browser and never uploaded to a server.
how_to.step3_text: Drag the frame to centre your face and use Zoom until your head fills the frame to the size the rules require.
how_to.step4_text: Download the PDF sheet and print it at actual size (100%, no "fit to page") on photo paper, then cut out the photos.

items.q: What size is a Pakistani passport photo?
items.a: 45 mm high by 35 mm wide, on a plain white background.

items.q: How old can my Pakistan passport photo be?
Can I use a cropped photo for online renewal?
items.a: DGIP asks for a professionally taken photo and says a photo cropped from a larger picture is not acceptable.

items.q: What photo is needed for a Pakistan visa?
items.a: Two photographs of 45 × 35 mm with a white background.
